description: End-to-end behavior corpus. Each case runs the skill FORCED-LOADED (bypassing discovery) and grades the ARTIFACTS ON DISK, not the trajectory. Forced load isolates behavior after loading; it cannot measure trigger quality - that is routing.json.
isolation: Fresh work dir per trial (RESEARCH_WORK_DIR=$(mktemp -d)) and a fresh agent session per case. Cases never share state. Set REPORT_OUTPUT_DIR into the same scratch tree so no case writes to the user's real reports dir.
grading: Deterministic checks in `checks[]` are the gate; `expectations[]` are human-readable intent. A trace check inspects the run transcript the runner captured; an artifact check inspects a file the run produced. Grade outcomes and invariants, never a specific read order.
arms: For a release comparison run the same cases under `no-skill`, `previous-release`, and `candidate` with identical model, harness, tools, and graders. See efficacy notes in README.md.

cases.prompt: deep research on configuring hierarchical indexing in Amazon OpenSearch Serverless - parent-child relationships, nested fields, efficient query mappings
expectations: Selects the comprehensive strategy and keeps the intent-default subagent set
Dispatches at least two researchers in one round, never more than four
Prints the decomposed subqueries with facet labels BEFORE dispatching
Produces <slug>-report.md that passes the mechanical report gate

checks.desc: never more than 4 subagents per round
parent never read a findings file (context isolation)
report contains concrete mapping examples in JSON code blocks

cases.prompt: show me the top 5 latest AWS security blog posts
expectations: Selects feed-only, which OVERRIDES the intent default set
Dispatches web-content-researcher only, and skips decomposition entirely
Maps to the security blog category feed

cases.prompt: what is the maximum number of knowledge bases you can create per account in Amazon Bedrock?
expectations: Selects docs-only, NARROWING to aws-mcp-researcher alone
Answers with a concrete number and cites an AWS documentation URL

checks.desc: cites an official AWS docs URL

cases.prompt: how much does Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 cost compared to provisioned Aurora? Include ACU pricing, storage, and I/O costs across regions
expectations: Selects pricing-focused, NARROWING to aws-mcp-researcher with the pricing flag
Report carries a Pricing & Cost Analysis section with specific dollar amounts
Citations include the pricing query date, since pricing is time-sensitive

checks.desc: Pricing & Cost Analysis section required and present

cases.prompt: research how to build a custom DevOps agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with tool definitions, custom workflows, and deployment patterns
expectations: Dispatches github-researcher and agentcore-researcher alongside aws-mcp-researcher
Report carries a Code Examples & Repositories section

cases.prompt: research the circuit breaker pattern in distributed systems - production lessons and failure modes
expectations: Classifies query-type as generic and passes it to every subagent
Skips aws-mcp-researcher entirely for a generic query
Uses web search as the primary source with query expansion

cases.prompt: deep research on Amazon S3 Express One Zone vs standard S3 - performance, pricing, and use cases
expectations: Subagent return text to the parent is minimal - a one-line write confirmation each
The parent reads only the finished report, never a findings file
The report is coherent despite the parent never seeing raw research data

checks.desc: HARD: parent read no findings file
combined subagent return text under 500 chars
no artifact written under the invocation CWD

cases.prompt: research what this page says about agent evaluation and how it compares to Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12670
expectations: Routes the direct URL through web-content-researcher, which writes direct-fetch.md
The parent never fetches the URL itself and never carries page content in a task string

checks.desc: direct URL fetched by a subagent, not the parent
HARD: parent made no fetch/web tool call

cases.prompt: review best practices for Bedrock Guardrails in production
expectations: The harness is detected and echoed BEFORE any dispatch
On pi / Claude Code: researchers dispatch as headless child processes via scripts/dispatch.sh
On Kiro: researchers dispatch in-session via the native subagent tool, no subprocess
No environment delegate-shaped tool is used on any harness

checks.desc: HARD: the harness actually loaded this SKILL.md - retain the load event
chosen harness and backend echoed before dispatch
no delegate-shaped tool, no kiro subprocess
the process disclaimer was printed before a process-fan-out round
